journey: Cmd/Ctrl+K opens the existing Kaneo command palette; each query is entered by direct sequential keyboard typing.
metric: Input-to-visible matching result latency; measured from the first typed character through the matching palette result becoming visible.
diagnosticMetrics: Per sample, records passive DOM input event timestamps/count, typing duration, and last-input-to-response/visible latency. The original input-to-visible p95 remains the acceptance metric.
